title: COALESCE does not evaluate the arguments after the first non-blank one
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", COALESCE ( [Order Count], ERROR ( "second argument" ) ) )

source.quote: COALESCE returns the first argument that is not BLANK .
source.supports: the first argument is returned when it is not BLANK

source.quote: To execute the branch expressions regardless of the condition expression, use IF.EAGER instead.
source.supports: IF, which COALESCE stands for, does not evaluate the branch it does not take

derivation: [Order Count] is 7, not BLANK. Reading COALESCE ( a, b ) as IF ( ISBLANK ( a ), b, a ), the second argument is not evaluated and the result is 7.
alternative: No source says whether COALESCE evaluates the arguments it does not return. If it evaluates all of them, the query fails with the error "second argument".
notes: The type is left out because ERROR has no data type.
